question: Who was appointed as UNICEF's celebrity advocate for a children's rights campaign in September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushmann Khurrana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• UNICEF India has announced Ayushmann Khurrana__ as its celebrity advocate for children’s rights campaign, For Every Child.
 
• Khurrana will support UNICEF towards ending violence against children.
 
• He will work towards this initiative in India and joins the likes of former football star David Beckham, who works on this campaign globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Basic Information about UNICEF:
 
 
• Founded: 1946.
 
• Headquarter: New York.
 
• Parent Agency: United Nations.
 
• Key Person: Catherine Russell
